title: Wareegama Fedhii
intro: Yeroo qormaata waaqummaa keessatti lubbuun tokko gara gocha isa dhumaa bitamuutti waamamte. Lafa baala hin qabne keessatti kan guddate lakkoofsi kun amantii fi obsa kan of keessaa qabu ta’ee guddate. Mul’anni tokko aarsaa yeroo ajaju hin raafaman. Seenaan isaanii dhagaa bu’uuraa of kennuudha.
clues: Kadhannaa raajii guddaa tokkoo yeroo dheeraaf eegamaa tureef deebii ani ture.
Aniifi haatikoo gammoojjii lafa onaa taʼeefi nyaata damee fi bishaan qofa qabnu keessatti hafne.
Raajii dhugaa fi obsa kootiin beekamu ta'ee guddadhe.
Abbaan koo bu’uura mana qulqulluu Rabbiif kenname akka ol kaasu gargaareera.
Abbaan koo abjuu na wareeguuf yeroo natti himu, anis, ‘Akkuma ajajamte raawwadhu’ jedheen deebiseef.
Rabbiin na furee korbeessa samii irraa erguun bitamuu koo kabaje.
arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
